description: This file contains code related to font rendering within the PDFsharp library, including a test class for Roti fonts, a font resolver implementation for custom fonts, and font data loading helpers.

classes.name: RotisWinAnsiTester
classes.description: A test class for rendering Rotis fonts in a PDF sample.

classes.name: RotisWinAnsiSnippet
classes.description: A snippet class that renders sample text with various Rotis fonts and styles.

classes.name: RotisFontResolver
classes.description: A custom font resolver for Rotis font family, providing font matching and data loading.

classes.name: RotisFontDataHelper
classes.description: Helper class that loads embedded font data resources for Rotis fonts.

methods.name: RotisWinAnsiTest
methods.description: Method in RotisWinAnsiTester that executes the font rendering test.

methods.name: RenderSnippet
methods.description: Overridden method in RotisWinAnsiSnippet that performs drawing of font samples on given graphics context.

methods.name: ResolveTypeface
methods.description: Resolves requested font typeface based on family, weight, and style, mapping to internal font resources.

methods.name: GetFont
methods.description: Retrieves the font data bytes for a specified font face.
